send_enabled.description: Enable --send: dispatch created request mails using sendmail

with_colons.description: Enable --with-colons: use colon-delimited output for domain support checks

output_file.description: Path to write output (e.g., for --check or --create); use '-' for stdout

status_fd.description: File descriptor number for status messages (0 = disabled)

blacklist_file.description: Path to a file listing email addresses to exclude from mirror operations

add_revocs.description: Append revocation certificates when installing keys (default: true)

quiet.description: Disable almost all informational output (overrides verbose)
